2609.03878.title: Differentiable Interval Bottlenecks for Interpretable Anomaly Detection in Numerical Data
2609.03878.paper_summary: Reconstruction-based anomaly detectors are accurate but opaque: a deep autoencoder flags a sample without telling a practitioner which feature ranges made it anomalous. We propose DIFFINT, an autoencoder whose latent bottleneck is structured as a set of soft, axis-aligned interval memberships learned end-to-end directly from raw numerical data, without any discretization or binarization. Each latent unit corresponds to a human-readable hyper-rectangle in feature space; an instance is encoded by how strongly it falls inside each interval relative to the other units, and its reconstruction error is the anomaly score. This keeps the power of differentiable representation learning while exposing an inspectable internal structure. We make the inductive bias precise: a certified reconstruction-error lower bound for points that fall outside every active coordinate of the learned support (with a Lipschitz-enforced decoder), and a graded, empirically verified suppression mechanism for the usual case in which only a few features are abnormal; and we provide a closed-form, label-free importance that ranks each (unit, feature) pair from quantities the model already maintains, turning trained intervals into auditable candidate constraints without ever seeing an anomaly label. On 48 ADBench benchmarks against 22 baselines under a common [-1, 1]-normalized protocol, DIFFINT attains the best mean rank overall on both metrics (4.10 on ROC-AUC, 4.16 on AUPR); among inlier-only detectors it leads its regime clearly, and it is competitive with the strongest contaminated-data detectors (see the stratified and complete-case analyses). It is the only interpretable detector in the statistically-tied leading cluster of seven methods.
2609.03878.paper_summary_zh: 重建基礎的異常檢測器準確但不透明：深度自編碼器標記樣本卻不告訴從業者哪些特徵範圍使其異常。我們提出了DIFFINT，一種其潛在瓶頸結構為一組軟性、軸對齊的區間隸屬關係，從原始數據中端到端學習，無需任何離散化或二元化。每個潛在單元對應於特徵空間中的一個人類可讀的超長方體；一個實例的編碼方式是它在相對於其他單元的每個區間內的強度，重建誤差則是異常分數。這保留了可微分表示學習的力量，同時暴露了一個可檢查的內部結構。我們使歸納偏差變得精確：對於落在學習支持的每個活躍坐標之外的點，提供了經過認證的重建誤差下界（配有Lipschitz強制的解碼器），以及對於通常只有少數特徵異常的情況，提供了一個經驗驗證的分級抑制機制；我們還提供了一個封閉形式的無標籤重要性，根據模型已經維護的數量對每個（單元，特徵）對進行排名，將訓練的區間轉化為可審計的候選約束，而無需看到異常標籤。在48個ADBench基準測試中，對比22個基線，在共同的[-1, 1]標準化協議下，DIFFINT在兩個指標上都獲得了最佳的平均排名（ROC-AUC為4.10，AUPR為4.16）；在僅限於正常值的檢測器中，它明顯領先於其範疇，並且在最強的污染數據檢測器中具競爭力（參見分層和完整案例分析）。它是七種方法中統計上並列領先集群中唯一可解釋的檢測器。
2609.03878.author: Lamine Diop et.al.
